about: Jujhar Logistics Ltd, formerly CDG Petchem Ltd, is an automotive-logistics company. Through 51%-owned Jujhar Logistic & Travels Ltd, it transports finished passenger vehicles from OEM plants and rail terminals to dealerships using specialised GPS/telematics-enabled car carriers. The network covers 600+ cities with 400+ carriers and serves major Indian and global automobile OEMs. [1] [2]
